next.reason: 1985: "A SUM clause can appear only in the description of a control footing report group."; 2023: "The current report group may be a detail and data-name-1 may be defined in a different detail. The current report group may be a report footing". 1985 limits SUM to control footings. 2023 also permits SUM in detail, report footing and page footing groups, and SR8 says 'If the current report group is a control footing', so the restriction is relaxed.
